page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r8ae.4xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by a dedicated AMD EPYC 9T34 processor clocked at 3.4 GHz with x86_64 architecture. The instance provides 16 vCPUs across 8 physical cores with two threads per core. Memory allocation totals 128.0 GB, yielding a 1:8 ratio of 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. It includes 32 KB L1 data cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and 32 MB L3 cache per core complex, supported by vector extensions including AVX-512, AVX512_VNNI, and AVX512_BF16, alongside AES and SHA cryptographic instruction sets. The instance includes no bundled local storage and features zero GPUs, relying on external network storage, and provides a baseline network bandwidth of 12 Gbps.

Benchmark results demonstrate strong single-core compute performance, placing in the top 25 percent with a stress-ng single-core score of 3100.68 and a Geekbench single-core score of 2012.0. Memory subsystems also place in the top 25 percent, evidenced by a PassMark memory score of 2754.77. In contrast, multi-core and multi-threaded throughput tests settle into the middle 50 percent range, including a multi-core stress-ng metric of 24930.74, Geekbench multi-core rating of 12095.0, and a PassMark CPU score of 26668.61. Memory bandwidth registers 49.58 GB/sec for uncached 256 MB reads and 28.02 GB/sec for uncached writes.

From an efficiency perspective, the instance provides dense memory allocation without requiring procurement of higher vCPU tiers. The primary tradeoff lies in the absence of onboard local storage, requiring network-attached storage architectures that interact with the 12 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. The system is well configured for in-memory databases, Redis caching layers, medium-scale database operations, text processing pipelines, and general enterprise data workloads that require high memory capacity relative to compute capacity.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r8ae.4xlarge is a memory-optimized instance featuring 16 dedicated vCPUs (8 physical cores) based on the 3.4 GHz AMD EPYC 9T34 processor and x86_64 architecture. Equipped with 128.0 GB of RAM, it maintains an 8:1 RAM-to-vCPU ratio suited for memory-intensive workloads. The instance does not feature bundled local storage or GPU hardware, relying on external storage solutions along with a 12 Gbps baseline network interface. Benchmark assessments indicate top-quartile single-core CPU throughput and strong memory responsiveness, matched with average multi-threaded execution and data manipulation scores. Supported by AVX-512 extensions and hardware cryptography accelerators, ecs.r8ae.4xlarge is designed for in-memory caching systems, distributed data caches such as Redis, relational and non-relational database management systems, and memory-heavy enterprise processing tasks.
